AppSession.description: Local-demo opaque preauth/current session; not an owner bearer
AppSession.name: ghost_demo_session

CsrfHeader.description: Required together with the cookie on every POST, including login/logout. Exact Origin/Host checks also apply; cookie security alone is insufficient.
CsrfHeader.name: X-Ghost-CSRF

info.description: LOCAL_DEMO is disabled by default and supports one owner/process on literal loopback only. Owner identity is server-derived. No browser bearer, owner, role or proxy headers. All reads validate Host/Origin/peer; POST requires the exact configured Origin and X-Ghost-CSRF bound to the HttpOnly SameSite=Strict preauth/session cookie. HTTPS uses __Host-ghost_session with Secure; explicit HTTP loopback uses ghost_demo_session without Secure. Cookies have Path=/ and no Domain. Expired/revoked sessions cannot access private results. Responses are no-store. Approval and metadata continuation never dispatch; UNKNOWN requires reconciliation, never an automatic resend. Catalog metadata does not authorize protected content.
